content: {"like":["Enjoys realistic, low‑prop sci‑fi suspense with baby‑boomer actors (e.g., The Invaders seasons).","Prefers films where veteran actors receive substantial roles and action (e.g., Space Cowboys).","Values nostalgic, vintage elements like classic cars in period dramas (e.g., Medical Center).","Appreciates high‑quality acting and photography in older TV series (e.g., Mannix).","Likes shows that blend procedural drama with classic detective vibes (e.g., Mannix)."],"dislike":["Dislikes modern watches lacking authenticity and gimmicks.","Rejects shows that age poorly or feel forced (e.g., Good Times, The Jeffersons).","Dislikes actors who underperform or are miscast (e.g., Donald Sutherland in Space Cowboys).","Dislikes weaker supporting roles that undercut veteran talent (e.g., Tommy Lee in Space Cowboys).","Avoids shows with excessive drama or social justice attempts that feel inauthentic."]}
